name: .NET User Group Karlsruhe: December meetup
description: monthly .NET user group meetup; topic not announced yet
details:
The .NET User Group Karlsruhe meets once a month for one or two talks on .NET, programming techniques and coding dojos. 17 Dec 2026 is still listed (checked 4 Nov) as a planned date on the group's call-for-speakers page; no topic, time or venue yet and no Meetup event so far.

Recent meetups ran at bluehands in Karlsruhe (Waldstr. 63) from 17:00 or 18:30 and were free. Check the group's Meetup page closer to the date.
note: German; planned date only, not on Meetup yet
